title: SendGrid keys in JSON and single-quoted environment values
summary: The SendGrid key shape as a JSON string value and as a single-quoted environment assignment, in base62 and URL-safe forms.
rationale: Quotes and JSON punctuation must not be absorbed into the value or cut into it, and a trailing dash sits right next to the closing quote, where an off-by-one is most likely.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The documented key format is present; the range is the key without the quotes.
